Where is Nobleton?

Nobleton is a community in the southwest of King Township, Ontario. This guide focuses on Nobleton, while linking to Township-wide resources where they serve local residents.

Nobleton on the Township website

Where do I find municipal information?

King Township’s official website is the source for municipal services, notices and community information. Nobleton.ca is an independent community guide and does not provide municipal services.

Visit King Township

Where can local businesses connect?

The King Chamber of Commerce serves businesses across the Township. Visit its website for current membership and event information.

Visit the King Chamber

Waste collection: start with your address

Use King Township’s waste calendar and collection-area map to find the schedule for your home. The Township also links to Recycle Coach for sorting questions. Extra garbage tags are sold through the Township and at King Township library branches, including Nobleton. Check current limits and accepted materials before putting items at the curb.

Collection resources and calendar links

Water and wastewater are property-specific

King Township operates local municipal water distribution in Nobleton and local wastewater collection where properties are connected. Do not assume every property has the same connections or charges. Before buying or renting, ask which services supply the address and where to arrange the account change.

Water billing and connection information

Keep one local contact sheet

Save your collection schedule, school office, library and service-provider contacts in one place. For municipal service questions, King Township lists 905-833-5321. For a business or community resource, browse our directory and contact the organization directly to confirm availability.

Browse local businesses and resources
